'''2005 World Championship Day 2 David Destefanis LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2005-09-05).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35129 The Perfect MBO WC 2005 - Europe]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061105211439/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35129&PHPSESSID=29818f8b6da266174ddd746571e9b090 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Also used at the 2005 European Championship; filed under 2005 Worlds. Bill to rule on the event.<ref name="src" />
